patterns: Direct naming items dominate: Bandobast = Dahsala (JPSC 2013), Zabti introduced by Akbar, Todar Mal = land revenue reforms.
Term-meaning one-liners: Maal = land revenue, Batai = system of revenue calculation, Deccan assessment by number of ploughs.
APPSC/AP angle is the Deccan: deshmukh as revenue collector (APPSC G1).
App adds Karori 1574, land classes and suba officials in multi-statement form; the mansabdari system itself (zat/sawar, do-aspa) has little app coverage here.
